html:
In early February 2008, I bought a Soligor 135mm F2.8 lens with a screw-in M42 mount. When I received it, I tried it with the SCT telescope to Canon EOS adapter. The threads aren't compatible. So I ordered an EOS/M42 adapter. Which I received yesterday. Everything works perfectly. Most importantly, it's possible to focus at infinity, which is essential for astrophotography.

Cost of the lens $9.99 + $8 shipping
Cost of the adapter $4 + $6 shipping

Grand total $28. I should get my money's worth.

Here are a few photos of the lens and the adapter.
